name: steam
description: Steam integration via the official Steam Web API — resolve vanity URLs, look up player profiles, list owned and recently played games with playtime, check per-game achievements, fetch game news, and get live player counts. Auth is a static Steam Web API key sent as the key query parameter; the game-news and current-player-count tools hit keyless endpoints and work without a key. Private or friends-only profiles return empty results. Powered by Steam. Steam is a trademark of Valve Corporation; this skill is not affiliated with or endorsed by Valve.
author: Buildersoft LLC

integration.description: Steam player profiles, game libraries, achievements, and game stats via the Steam Web API

fields.label: Steam Web API Key
fields.helpText: Get a key at steamcommunity.com/dev/apikey (requires a non-limited Steam account, i.e. at least $5 spent). Optional — the game-news and current-player-count tools work without it.

fields.label: Default SteamID64
fields.helpText: Optional 64-bit SteamID (e.g. 76561197960287930) used by library and achievement tools when no steamId argument is given. Use steam.resolve_vanity_url to find yours.

tools.name: steam.resolve_vanity_url
tools.description: Resolve a Steam Community vanity URL name (the custom name in steamcommunity.com/id/<name>) to a 64-bit SteamID.

vanityUrl.description: The vanity name to resolve, e.g. 'gabelogannewell' for steamcommunity.com/id/gabelogannewell

tools.name: steam.get_player_summary
tools.description: Get profile summaries (persona name, profile URL, online state, current game) for one or more players. Accepts a comma-separated list of SteamID64s; falls back to the connection's default_steam_id.

steamIds.description: Comma-separated 64-bit SteamIDs (up to 100). Defaults to the connection's default_steam_id.

tools.name: steam.get_owned_games
tools.description: List the games a player owns with total playtime, sorted by most played. Includes free games that have been played. Returns empty for private/friends-only profiles.

steamId.description: 64-bit SteamID. Defaults to the connection's default_steam_id.

limit.description: Max games to return (default 50, max 500); count still reflects the full library size.

tools.name: steam.get_recently_played
tools.description: List games a player has played in the last two weeks with recent and total playtime. Returns empty for private/friends-only profiles.

steamId.description: 64-bit SteamID. Defaults to the connection's default_steam_id.

count.description: Max games to return (max 50; omit for all)

tools.name: steam.get_player_achievements
tools.description: Get a player's achievement progress for one game: total achievements, how many are unlocked, and the list of unlocked achievement names. Requires the profile's game details to be public.

steamId.description: 64-bit SteamID. Defaults to the connection's default_steam_id.

appId.description: Steam app id of the game, e.g. 440 for Team Fortress 2

tools.name: steam.get_app_news
tools.description: Get the latest news posts for a game (patch notes, announcements, community posts). Keyless — works without a Steam Web API key.

appId.description: Steam app id of the game, e.g. 730 for Counter-Strike 2

count.description: Number of news items to return (default 5, max 20)

tools.name: steam.get_current_players
tools.description: Get the current number of players in-game for a Steam app right now. Keyless — works without a Steam Web API key.

appId.description: Steam app id of the game, e.g. 570 for Dota 2
